simple.meaning: a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַסַּע (H4550) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: מַסַּע (maççaʻ) means a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure ) First listed occurrence: Deut 10 11.

definitions.short: a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure )
definitions.full: H4550. massa מַסַּע noun [masculine] pulling up, breaking camp, setting out, journey ; — absolute ׳מ Num 10:2 ; Deut 10:11 ; plural construct מַסְעֵי Num 10:28 ; 33:1 ; suffix מַסָּעָיו Gen 13:3 , מַסְעֵיהֶם Exod 17:1 6 t.; — 1. a. pulling up, breaking camp (with accusative מַחֲנֶה ; Ges § 45e , 115d) Num 10:2 . b. setting out Num 10:6 , compare 10:23 . 2 station, stage, journey (by stages), לְמ ׳וַיֵּלֶךְ Gen 13:3 and he went by (according to) his journeyings (compare הלך , p. 231 a above); לְמַסְעֵיהֶם Exod 17:1 ; compare 40:36 , 38 ; Num 10:12 (all P; all with נָסַע ), 33:1-2 ,(|| מוֺצָאֵיהֶם ), 33:2 (|| id. ); לְמַסַּע לֵךְ קוּם Deut 10:11 for journeying (see Dr).
